description:
1. Read SKILL.md to understand the memory-manager architecture: session files go to memory/temp/session_*.md, daily summary to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, weekly distillation updates MEMORY.md, stale files (>30 days) get deleted.
2. Parse the 5 raw conversation logs from raw_conversations/ and create 5 structured session files at memory/temp/session_*.md, each containing the 5 required fields: topic (主题), key info (关键信息), todos (待办), decisions (决策), emotional state (情感).
3. Run the daily summary process: aggregate all 5 session files into a single daily report at memory/2026-03-09.md (exact date-named file in memory/ directory) containing 4 required sections: completed tasks (今天完成的任务), new knowledge (学到的新知识), important decisions (重要决策记录), next-day todos (明日待办事项). Then DELETE all session temp files.
4. Since 2026-03-09 is a Sunday, run the weekly distillation: create/update MEMORY.md in the workspace root with 4 long-term memory categories: user preferences (用户偏好), important decisions (重要决策), lessons learned (经验教训), growth trajectory (成长轨迹). Must include key facts like Acme Corp preferences, AWS→GCP decision, Excel format preference, Jenkins CI lesson.
5. Clean up stale files: delete memory/2026-02-05.md and memory/2026-02-01.md which are more than 30 days before 2026-03-09.
